binder_ledger.quantifiers: All point supports produced at every p in box; growth holds for EVERY global g, not only displayed covector. First interpolation requires strict source weights. Negative case has all real endpoints and no source support existence.

first_conj_provider.required: Iff.mpr of stronglyConvex_iff_sourceSubgradient_growth at d2,e=scaledCoordinates,f=objective,V=feasible,lam1 with internally proved properness, convex box, nonnegative coefficient, all-point hsub, and independently proved EVERY-g growth.
first_conj_provider.forbidden: Do not prove growth by calling the forward iff/adapter using the desired interpolation; do not merely return an independently proved interpolation with a decorative iff call.
first_conj_provider.genuine_growth_route: Global quadratic supports have unique covector=(p+(1,0))/2 in scaled coordinates. Derive this algebraically from the global support inequality at a displacement chosen from the gradient mismatch; the residual squared sum forces mismatch zero. Then exact quadratic expansion bounds sup-norm squared by sum of squares. No prior strong interpolation theorem is used to derive the growth premise.
first_conj_provider.global_hsub: For each feasible p (indeed every ambient p), displayed covector supports at every ambient coordinate u by nonnegative quadratic remainder. Globals remain globals; no merely box-local support.
first_conj_provider.norm_discrimination: At q=(1,1), original squared norm1, scaled coordinate squared norm8, covector pairing1, f(q)=2. Wrong coordinate penalty yields5<=2 and is explicitly negated.
first_conj_provider.strict_source_residual: At x=q,y=-q,a=1/2,z0,g=covector0, weighted pairings cancel, but weighted function/curvature residual=1/2. Thus printed equality to0 is false; source corrected inequality remains true.

negative_case.function: f(t)=-t^2 is globally real/proper, V=R convex, lambda0.
negative_case.support_empty_route: For any p and supposed scalar g, test the global inequality at p+1 and p-1. Expanding gives g<=-2p-1 and g>=-2p+1, contradiction.
negative_case.vacuous_growth: Every support-indexed implication is true because no support exists, with no use of iff under invalid hsub.
negative_case.source_scope: Counterexample to REMOVING hsub, not to Lemma4.2. Properness and domain inclusion alone do not make right-side universal supports nonvacuous.
